recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. Any future edits to service-category or service-type CodeSystem definitions should be made in the UTG/THO source of truth, not in this FHIR-core checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-35965 was Applied/Persuasive for HealthcareService terminology and requested changing the HL7-defined service-category and service-type CodeSystems from content=example to content=complete. Jira comments clarified this was distinct from the HealthcareService example-strength bindings.
initial_application: No direct FHIR-core commit mentioning FHIR-35965 or UP-529 was found for HealthcareService source. The application path is UP-529, a Proposal Implemented/Done UTG change proposal listing CodeSystem-service-category.xml and CodeSystem-service-type.xml as modified THO source-of-truth files.
additional_context: Core source/fhir.ini includes HealthcareService in the active build, and the HealthcareService StructureDefinition binds category/type at example strength to ValueSets that include the THO CodeSystems. Those value set descriptions and binding strengths are not the CodeSystem.content field targeted by FHIR-35965. Confluence references show PA approval and THO 5.5.0 publication for FHIR-35965/UP-529; Zulip evidence points to the UP-529 UTG diff and did not reveal contrary service-category/service-type content guidance.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No FHIR-core source file was changed because the source-of-truth CodeSystem content fields live in UTG/THO and current terminology.hl7.org JSON for both CodeSystems reports content=complete.
